task_definition.task_description: Please check whether Alice is available on 2026-01-16, then find a meeting room for that day at 9:00 AM that can fit at least 6 people. After that, get my checking account balance sheet and archive it as a high-priority email titled Quarterly Balance Archive, then check whether NASDAQ is open, estimate the trading cost for a $2,500 stock trade on my VIP tier, and assess the risk for the resulting amount. Then look up the Hilton Tokyo details, create and email me a high-priority document called Hotel Options for Business Trip with that hotel information, and finally set a high-priority reminder for 2026-01-16 18:00 to review the trip planning summary using the notification message.
